page.layout: Two columns of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin and a short catchword-free foot. Left margin: notes marked NB and letter-mark notes (Semina, inreci-, baria vfi-, tata, Sinapi, praftatia). Main text in one block of lines, with a bare "CAP." at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: NB. menthæ Sarracenicæ, rofmarini, amenthæ vulgaris, matricariæ, & fimilibus. ad placen-tas quas taganitas vocant (Pfanfuchen) ó-diendas vsus frequentissimus est, præsertim verno tempore, estq; harum vsus & efus isto tempore noninfalutaris, ventriculo enim & medicamento & alimento funt. Hactenus de alimentis quæ veniunt ex radicibus, quibus, quia ciborum potius cõdimenta funt, quàm cibi, qui proprie alimentum præstare ex-sti-Semina mantur, annumerari possunt, femina, quæ ininreci- præcipuis ac laudatissimis saluberrimisq; ho-baria vfi- die condimentis escarum variarum habetur,tata. vt sunt, anifi, feniculi, cari, apii, anethi, fina-Sinapi pi, quod præcipuam nobilitatem in condi-praftatia. mentis carnium, vt bubulæ præsertim infu-matæ, item piscium obtinuit: matres familiâs obsonatricis artis non imperitæ per vinde-mias multo id diluunt temperantq; ad acri-moniam eius retundendam, vnde adhuc mu-stardæ nomè à multo & ardore retinuisse vi-detur. Insigniter autem prodest, quibus pala-tum torpescit, quosq; cibi fastidium mole-stat, cerebrum quoq; purgat, sed inualidio-NB. ribus aridisq; oculis infigniter noxium: ari-dos oculos voco tabidos, saccidos, debiles, roridæ sc. humiditatis ratione, ea enim deficiente oculos aridos existere debilesq; necesse est.

page.notes: Printed page is a 16th/17th-century Latin page with long s, Pfanfuchen in Fraktur-style print; some margin notes are cut and partly illegible at the left edge (e.g., "inreci-", "baria vfi-", "tata", "praftatia" are fragments of catchwords or cut-off marginal words). Several words in the margin are not fully legible and were transcribed as best read; the scan is faded and right-edge text is partly lost. Ambiguous readings: "taganitas", "Pfanfuchen", "infu-", "matres familiâs" (possibly "matres familias"), "ari-". Greek and Hebrew: none visible. The printed "NB." marks are marginal manicules/notes, not text.
